title: Mark Active Window In Mode
description: Mode dock tabs in single-window stacks all looked selected because styling used stack-local activeId only. Global activeWindowId must mark the focused tab and window.
summary: Mode dock tabs now use global activeWindowId for focus styling (bg-active-base on the active tab; stack-local activeId only affects which tab is shown in a multi-tab stack). Added data-stack-active vs data-active on tabs, data-active on stacks, ring-active-base on the focused Window, and onPointerDownCapture so canvas clicks activate the window. Extended vitest and Mode.stories QuadLayout play assertions.
